description: Balanced D24 scorecard. Every measure is labelled by source. Primary measures exist for every condition and may be compared and weighted; diagnostic measures are condition-specific and are never compared across conditions or weighted (ADR-0004 guarantees 4 and 6).

measures.name: task_oracle_pass_rate
measures.description: Task oracles passing at the final check, divided by task oracles.

measures.name: regression_oracle_pass_rate
measures.description: Regression oracles passing at the final check, divided by regression oracles; null when the task declares none.

measures.name: failed_sessions
measures.description: Sessions that exited non-zero, timed out or could not start.

measures.name: review_verdict
measures.description: Verdict of the blinded, condition-neutral review procedure.

measures.name: review_blocking_findings
measures.description: Blocking findings from the blinded review procedure.

measures.name: review_non_blocking_findings
measures.description: Non-blocking findings from the blinded review procedure.

measures.name: trap_recurrences
measures.description: Trap oracles failing at the final check: a seeded known mistake was repeated.

measures.name: rework_sessions
measures.description: Fix sessions run because task oracles failed after the planned sessions.

measures.name: session_seconds
measures.description: Wall-clock time of all agent sessions, excluding condition setup and oracles.

measures.name: input_tokens
measures.description: Input tokens reported by the agent tool; never verified.

measures.name: output_tokens
measures.description: Output tokens reported by the agent tool; never verified.

measures.name: total_tokens
measures.description: Input plus output tokens reported by the agent tool; never verified.

measures.name: turns
measures.description: Agent turns reported by the agent tool, where it reports them.

measures.name: tool_calls
measures.description: Agent tool calls reported by the agent tool, where it reports them.

measures.name: tool_seconds:*
measures.description: Wall-clock time in a wrapped declared tool. Primary only when the tool resolves in every run of the plan; otherwise a diagnostic.

measures.name: tool_invocations:*
measures.description: Invocations of a wrapped declared tool, under the same rule as tool_seconds.

measures.name: setup_seconds
measures.description: Wall-clock time of the condition's own setup commands; recorded separately from agent execution.

measures.name: keystone_envelope_tokens
measures.description: Estimated tokens of a generated START envelope found in the workspace after the final session.

measures.name: keystone_envelope_omissions
measures.description: Omissions recorded in that START envelope.

measures.name: keystone_validation_diagnostics
measures.description: Keystone structural validation diagnostics in the final workspace, computed read-only after the final session.
